cssStyles.description: A set of CSS rules that modify the visual presentation and layout appearance.
cssStyles.label: Custom CSS Styles

description.description: A short summary that describes the {{document}}.
description.label: Description

inlineStyles.description: A CSS properties object that modifies the visual presentation and layout appearance.
inlineStyles.label: Inline CSS Styles

slug.description: A unique, indexed, URL-friendly string that identifies a particular document, often used to construct the URL of a webpage.
slug.label: Slug

accent.description: A highlight color for active, focused, or hover states.
accent.label: Accent Color

accentForeground.description: The text and icon color used on top of accent colored elements.
accentForeground.label: Accent Foreground

background.description: The main canvas color for the entire application or component's background.
background.label: Background Color

border.description: The default color for component borders.
border.label: Border Color

card.description: The background color for `Card` components and similar containers (e.g., `DropdownMenu`, `HoverCard`, `Popover`).
card.label: Card Color

cardForeground.description: The text and icon color for content within `Card` components.
cardForeground.label: Card Foreground

dataGroup.description: A palette of color tokens designed for charts and graphs.
dataGroup.label: Data Visualization Tokens

destructive.description: The color for error states and destructive actions, such as delete buttons.
destructive.label: Destructive Color

destructiveForeground.description: The text and icon color on top of destructive colored elements.
destructiveForeground.label: Destructive Foreground

foreground.description: The default text and icon color used on top of the main background.
foreground.label: Foreground Color

input.description: The border color specifically for form input elements like Input, Select, and Textarea.
input.label: Input Color

muted.description: A subtle background color used for components requiring less attention, such as TabsList, Skeleton, or Switch backgrounds.
muted.label: Muted Color

mutedForeground.description: De-emphasized text color, often used for captions, labels, or placeholders.
mutedForeground.label: Muted Foreground

outlineGroup.description: Single-value tokens used to define layout boundaries and interactive states.
outlineGroup.label: Outline Tokens

popover.description: The background color for popovers, select menus, and similar temporary overlays.
popover.label: Popover Color

popoverForeground.description: The text and icon color for content within popovers.
popoverForeground.label: Popover Foreground

primary.description: The main brand/accent color, typically used for primary buttons and key interactive elements.
primary.label: Primary Color

primaryForeground.description: The text and icon color on top of primary colored elements to ensure readability and contrast.
primaryForeground.label: Primary Foreground

radius.description: Defines the global border radius for all components.
radius.label: Border Radius

ring.description: The color used for the focus indicator (outline ring) when an element is focused.
ring.label: Ring Color

secondary.description: A secondary brand color or a light variant used for less prominent elements or secondary buttons.
secondary.label: Secondary Color

secondaryForeground.description: The text and icon color on top of secondary colored elements.
secondaryForeground.label: Secondary Foreground

semanticGroup.description: Tokens that follow a background / foreground pairing convention, which communicate component hierarchy, state, and intent.
semanticGroup.label: Semantic Tokens

surfaceGroup.description: Tokens that follow a background / foreground pairing convention, where the base token defines the container fill and the -foreground variant defines the text and icon color inside it.
surfaceGroup.label: Surface Tokens

site-footer.description: The bottom-most visible section of a webpage that acts as a navigation safety net and conversion anchor for users who reach the end of a scroll.
site-footer.label: Site Footer

site-header.description: The top-most visible section of a webpage that remains consistent across your site to establish brand identity and guide user navigation.
site-header.label: Site Header

plugin-seo.imageDescription: This should be an image that adheres to the Open Graph recommended 1.91:1 aspect ratio — ideally 1200×630 with the primary contents contained within the inner 1000×500.
